title: April Guest Artist Michael Giaquinto
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder March 1, 2017

The Guild of Harwich Artists is offering the public a free opportunity to view the creation of a new painting. If you have ever wondered how artists go about deciding what to paint, or how they might begin a new work, come and see how one artist does it! Artist and teacher Michael Giaquinto will present a demonstration on Saturday, April 15, 2017, at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, starting at about 2:20 PM (right after a brief GHA business meeting), using his favorite media, acrylic paint on canvas.

The Guild of Harwich Artists hold monthly meetings September through May at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak Street, Harwich. Each meeting features a well known Cape Cod artist demonstrator. All programs are free and open to the public.
